title: Mechanics of the Ski–Snow Contact
access: Publisher full HTML; PDF challenge response excluded
evidence: Hard well-sintered snow, density 500 kg/m3; normal impact at -6 C, about 100 ms, peak 140 N. Topography plus model gives approximately 0.3 N/contact and 0.4% real area.
exclusion: Neither a direct single-contact force measurement nor fresh groomed sliding at 50 C. Not used as a target or constitutive input.

title: The Snow-Friction of Freestyle Skis and Snowboards Predicted From Snow Physical Quantities
access: Full HTML and PDF; PDF page 8 Table 5 rendered and visually checked
evidence: Hydrocarbon-waxed ski bases; resistance inferred from kinematics, aerodynamics and force balance. COF_start follows 4 m gliding, not static friction.
exclusion: Speed entries beyond each reported maximum are withheld here; endpoint handling not established from reviewed text. No extrapolation to unwaxed 50 C candidates.
